name: Extra Strength Glass Cleaner

features.text: Removes dirt, grime, smoke film, fingerprints.

description: A concentrated, VOC-compliant cleaner that excels at removing stubborn vinyl & smoker's haze on the interior vehicle glass. Contains no ammonia.
application: DIRECTIONS: 1) Dilute 1 part product to at least 18 parts water. 2) Spray on soiled surface or wipe on with a clean cloth. 3) Wipe area with a dry, clean, lint-free cloth or towel until dry and streak free.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Concentration - 4
